## Notes

The transcript reports "Seal: intact. No record changed after the end of the test." The audit has no breaks, errors or blocked calls, and findings.json contains no findings. I checked all three turns against the saved spec and rules, tool arguments and results, backend responses, expected trace points and performance limits. I also read app.py, entry.py, services.py, stock.py and toy_model.py, and checked the current state.json and stock.json without changing app state.

Both stock replies agree with their tool and backend results. Order 6210's item, price and status agree with its lookup result and current state. Current stock is 3 teapot sets and 12 blue mugs, with no reservations shown. These current files are corroboration, not sealed snapshots. There is no app-state snapshot folder or tester notes file.

Turn durations were 4.26, 61.413 and 3.238 seconds against the 30-second limit. Model sessions together used 138, 154 and 126 output tokens against the 2000-token limit. Both limits could be checked for every turn. Direct model API usage is partly unknown, but the spec excludes those calls from the token limit. The trace does not establish the cause of the full turn-2 delay.

No reservation, return, refund, unrelated-topic or other-customer request was tested, so this record does not establish behavior for those cases. No additional issue is supported by the observed turns.
